descriptionChirho: The personal name Nethaniah/Netanyahu (נְתַנְיָהוּ), meaning 'Yahweh has given,' borne by several individuals in the Hebrew Bible. All three clusters represent the same name with grammatical variation: bare form, conjunction waw ('and Nethaniah'), and the longer theophoric spelling. Cross-lingual transliterations are consistent: Arabic نَتَنْيَا/نَثَنْيَا (Natanya/Nathanya), Swahili 'Nethaniya/Nethania,' Hindi नतन्याह/नतन्याहू, Korean 느단야/느타냐/느단니야, Spanish 'Netanías/Netanyahu.' Appears in 2 Kgs 25:23,25; Jer 36:14, 40:8,14-15, 41:1-18; 1 Chr 25:2,12; 2 Chr 17:8.
